summary_md: **Arnaud Mercier - #Entrepreneur #Versailles ([@arnaudmercier](https://x.com/arnaudmercier/status/2115726971560767767))** shares **Prospector** ([arXiv 2610.37121](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.37121)), from MIT, which learns a compact graph-traversal policy over knowledge graphs for scientific reasoning in specialized engineering domains where the knowledge is scattered across the literature and frontier models tend to answer generically.
relevance: Small learned policies for structured scientific reasoning.
